project.name: E-commerce Mobile Application (fictional demo)
project.description: Fictional demo project. A mid-sized fashion retailer wants a mobile shopping app for iOS and Android: product catalogue, cart, checkout with online payments, and order tracking. Launch is tied to a seasonal campaign, so the 6-month deadline is strict. The €50,000 budget is a preferred maximum and can flex slightly for a strong proposal.

criteria.name: Duration
criteria.description: Must launch within 6 months for the seasonal campaign.

criteria.name: Budget
criteria.description: Preferred maximum of €50,000; small overruns are acceptable for a strong proposal.

criteria.description: One shared codebase for iOS and Android.
